name: Default
shortDescription: Continuwuity, a lightweight Rust Matrix homeserver with embedded RocksDB storage and federation on port 443 through a served .well-known.

alerts.message: On first start the container logs print a one-time registration token. Use it to register the first account from a Matrix client; that account becomes the server admin and is invited to the admin room.
The domain becomes the Matrix server name (user IDs look like @alice:your-domain). Set the final domain before the first start; it cannot be changed later without wiping the database.
